note: Prices are directional estimates based on public list pricing and free-tier / paid-tier details for each observability platform. Confirm current rates before budgeting. Some platforms charge by span, event, trace, unit, seat, or data volume; numbers here are approximations for side-by-side comparison.

providers.name: Langfuse Cloud — Hobby
providers.notes: Free for up to 50k units/mo (traces + observations + scores). 2 users, 30-day access. Best for prototypes.

providers.name: Langfuse Cloud — Core
providers.notes: $29/mo, 100k units included, unlimited users, then $8 per 100k units. Unit = trace, observation, or score.
providers.best_for: Startups and small teams with moderate volume

providers.name: Langfuse Cloud — Pro
providers.notes: $199/mo for 3-year retention, SOC2/ISO, high rate limits. Same unit overage as Core.
providers.best_for: Teams needing long retention and compliance

providers.name: Langfuse Cloud — Enterprise
providers.notes: $2,499/mo base with SLA, dedicated support, custom rate limits.
providers.best_for: Large orgs with custom security / support needs

providers.name: LangSmith — Developer
providers.notes: Free for 1 seat + 5k base traces/mo (14-day retention). Overage ~$0.50 per 1k base traces.

providers.name: LangSmith — Plus
providers.notes: $39/seat/mo. 10k base traces total included per month; overage $0.50/1k base traces. Seat cost adds up fast.
providers.best_for: Teams already committed to LangChain / LangGraph

providers.name: Arize AX — Free
providers.notes: 25k spans/mo and 1 GB ingestion free. 15-day retention. Unlimited users.

providers.name: Arize AX — Pro
providers.notes: $50/mo, 50k spans + 10 GB included. Overage ~$10/1M spans + $3/GB. 30-day retention.

providers.name: Laminar — Free
providers.notes: 1 GB/mo free, 7-day retention, unlimited seats. Built for agent trace compression.

providers.name: Laminar — Hobby
providers.notes: $30/mo includes 3 GB; additional GB at $2. 30-day retention.

providers.name: Laminar — Pro
providers.notes: $150/mo includes 10 GB; additional GB at $1.50. 6-month retention, unlimited projects.

providers.name: Helicone — Free
providers.notes: 10k logged requests/mo free, 7-day retention. Open-source gateway available.

providers.name: Helicone — Pro
providers.notes: $79/mo for ~1M requests and longer retention. Usage-priced beyond plan. Good gateway value.
providers.best_for: Teams using an AI gateway for routing and logs

providers.name: Datadog Agent Observability
providers.notes: ~$200/mo for 100k LLM spans; $4 per 10k additional LLM spans. Non-LLM spans often free. Best if already on Datadog.
providers.best_for: Enterprises already paying for Datadog APM

providers.name: Braintrust — Starter
providers.notes: Free 1M spans/mo + 1 GB + 10k eval scores. Eval-first platform.

providers.name: Braintrust — Pro
providers.notes: $249/mo base. Overages likely on data/processed GB and eval scores. Check vendor for current rates.
providers.best_for: Teams running CI/CD eval gates at scale

providers.name: AgentOps — Pro
providers.notes: $40/mo base with 5k free events. Unlimited events on Pro according to public sources. Agent-specific instrumentation.

providers.name: Honeycomb — Pro
providers.notes: $150/mo starting at 50M events. Event-based pricing; agent spans map to events. Great for high-cardinality telemetry.
providers.best_for: Teams already on Honeycomb or event-native APM

providers.name: Pydantic Logfire — Free
providers.notes: 10M spans/mo free. OTel-native, SQL-queryable. Excellent free tier.

providers.name: Pydantic Logfire — Team
providers.notes: $49/mo base with 10M spans included; overage $2 per 1M spans. Spend caps available.
providers.best_for: Python-first teams that want predictable span pricing

providers.name: Self-hosted (Langfuse OSS / Laminar OSS / Phoenix)
providers.notes: Open-source self-host: no per-seat or per-span fees. You pay compute, storage, and engineering time. Add compute below.
providers.best_for: Privacy-sensitive or high-volume teams with SRE capacity

faq.question: What billable unit should I expect for agent observability?
faq.answer: It varies by platform. LangSmith bills per trace plus seats; Langfuse bills per unit (trace + observation + score); Arize, Datadog, Sentry, and Logfire bill per span; AgentOps and Honeycomb bill per event; Laminar and Helicone bill by data volume or request. A single agent run with 20 tool calls can create 50+ spans, so the unit matters a lot.

faq.question: When is self-hosted observability cheaper?
faq.answer: At high span volume, per-span SaaS fees dominate. Self-hosting Langfuse, Laminar, or Phoenix shifts cost to compute and SRE time. Break-even often appears above a few hundred thousand to millions of spans per month, depending on seat count and data retention.

faq.question: How does sampling affect cost?
faq.answer: Sampling 10% of production traces cuts billable units roughly 10x while keeping enough signal for error investigation and trend dashboards. Many teams sample healthy traffic heavily and keep 100% of errors or slow traces.

faq.question: Do I need a separate APM if I use an agent observability tool?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Agent-native tools like Laminar and Langfuse cover traces, logs, evals, and dashboards. But if your org already pays for Datadog or New Relic, the integrated LLM Observability module can avoid duplicate data pipelines and give unified alerts.

faq.question: Which tool is best for LangGraph agents?
faq.answer: LangSmith has the deepest native integration, including LangGraph Studio. Langfuse, Laminar, and Arize Phoenix also auto-instrument LangGraph via OpenTelemetry or native SDKs.

faq.question: Why does engineering time matter in the estimate?
faq.answer: Self-hosted and multi-tool setups need instrumentation, dashboard building, alert tuning, retention management, and security review. Enterprise SaaS tools reduce this but require integration, RBAC, and workflow setup. We cost that time separately so you compare true TCO.
